2014_spells.irresistible-dance.descripti: Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell. A dancing creature must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on dexterity saving throws and attack rolls. While the target is affected by this spell, other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, a dancing creature makes a wisdom saving throw to regain control of itself. On a successful save, the spell ends.
2014_spells.irresistible-dance.effectSum: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.irresistible-dance.fullDescr: Using 1 action, choose one creature that you can see within range. A dancing creature must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on dexterity saving throws and attack rolls; As an action, a dancing creature makes a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC to regain control of itself. On a successful save, the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
